240: u8 cal_crc8_0x31(u8 *data_buf, u16 len)
241: {
242: 	u8    crc = 0x00;

282: static mb_ipc_route_t * ipc_router_search_route(u8 dst_cpu, u32 * route_id)
283: {
284: 	mb_ipc_route_t  * ipc_route = NULL;
285: 
286: 	for(int i = 0; i < ARRAY_SIZE(ipc_route_tbl); i++)
287: 	{
288: 		if(ipc_route_tbl[i].dst_cpus & (0x01 << dst_cpu))
289: 		{
290: 			ipc_route = &ipc_route_tbl[i];
291: 			*route_id = i;
292: 			break;
293: 		}
294: 	}
295: 
296: 	return ipc_route;
297: }
298: 
299: /*
300:  * because ipc_cmd is a pointer, 
301:  * it may pending in the tx_queue, 
302:  * so the memory ipc_cmd pointed must **NOT** be in stack (temporary memory).
303:  * 
304:  */
305: static int ipc_router_send(mb_ipc_route_t *ipc_route, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd)
306: {
307: 	int   queue_cnt; // number of items in the queue.
308: 	int   free_cnt;
309: 
310: 	/* used to protect ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_in_idx. */
311: 	u32 temp = mb_ipc_enter_critical();
312: 
313: 	if(ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_in_idx >= ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_out_idx)
314: 	{
315: 		queue_cnt = ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_in_idx - ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_out_idx;
316: 		free_cnt  = ARRAY_SIZE(ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue) - queue_cnt;
317: 	}
318: 	else
319: 	{
320: 		free_cnt  = ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_out_idx - ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_in_idx;
321: 		queue_cnt = ARRAY_SIZE(ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue) - free_cnt;
322: 	}
323: 	
324: 	if( free_cnt <= 1 )  // reserved one for empty judgement.
325: 	{
326: 		mb_ipc_exit_critical(temp);
327: 		
328: 		return  IPC_ROUTE_QUEUE_FULL;
329: 	}
330: 	
331: 	u16  tx_idx = ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_in_idx;
332: 	
333: 	// memcpy(&ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue[tx_idx], ipc_cmd, sizeof(mb_ipc_cmd_t));
334: 	ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue[tx_idx].mb_cmd.hdr.data = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.hdr.data;
335: 	ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue[tx_idx].mb_cmd.param1 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1;
336: 	ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue[tx_idx].mb_cmd.param2 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2;
337: 	ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue[tx_idx].mb_cmd.param3 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3;
338: 	
339: 	tx_idx = (tx_idx + 1) % ARRAY_SIZE(ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue);
340: 	ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_in_idx = tx_idx;
341: 
342: 	mb_ipc_exit_critical(temp);  /* used to protect ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_in_idx. */
343: 
344: 	// it is the first item pushed to the queue, then try to send.
345: 	if(queue_cnt == 0)
346: 	{
347: 		mb_chnl_write(ipc_route->log_chnl, &ipc_cmd->mb_cmd);
348: 	}
349: 
350: 	return IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK;
351: }

353: /* 
354:  * it MUST be protected by critical-section.
355:  * it is called by RX-ISR.
356:  */
357: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
358: static int ipc_router_fwd(mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd)
359: {
360: 	u32               route_id;
361: 	mb_ipc_route_t  * ipc_route = ipc_router_search_route(ipc_cmd->dst_cpu, &route_id);
362: 
363: 	if(ipc_route == NULL)
364: 	{
365: 		// no route for this destination cpu.
366: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNREACHABLE;
367: 	}
368: 
369: 	// forward this cmd.
370: 	return ipc_router_send(ipc_route, ipc_cmd);
371: }
372: #endif

374: static void ipc_router_rx_isr(void *param, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
375: {
376: 	mb_ipc_cmd_t     * ipc_cmd = (mb_ipc_cmd_t *)cmd_buf;
377: 
378: 	#if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
379: 	/* please refer to <design document> P45 rx_isr 2). */
380: 	// if it is a fwd cmd/rsp.
381: 	if( ipc_cmd->dst_cpu != CURRENT_CPU )  // it is not for me, then forward it.
382: 	{
383: 		BK_ASSERT(CURRENT_CPU == MAILBOX_CPU1); // in current configuration, CPU1 used to forward cmd.
384: 
385: 		ipc_cmd->route_status = ipc_router_fwd(ipc_cmd);
386: 
387: 		return;
388: 	}
389: 	#endif
390: 
391: 	// it is for me, process the cmd/rsp.
392: 
393: 	// find the ipc_socket connection for the cmd/rsp.
394: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket;
395: 	ipc_socket = ipc_socket_search_recver(ipc_cmd->dst_port, ipc_cmd->src_cpu, ipc_cmd->src_port);
396: 
397: 	ipc_cmd->route_status = ipc_socket_rx_handler(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
398: 
399: 	#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
400: 	if(ipc_cmd->route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK)
401: 	{
402: 		// ipc_socket may be == NULL, don't reference it.
403: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "rx error: cmd-%02x, param1=%08x!\r\n", 
404: 			ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1);
405: 	}
406: 	#endif
407: 
408: 	return;
409: }

411: static void ipc_router_tx_cmpl_isr(void *param, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
412: {
413: 	mb_ipc_cmd_t     * ipc_cmd = (mb_ipc_cmd_t *)ack_buf;
414: 	u32                route_id = (u32)param;
415: 
416: 	// data sanity check.
417: 	if(route_id >= ARRAY_SIZE(ipc_route_tbl))
418: 	{
419: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "%s error @%d, id=%d!\r\n", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, route_id);
420: 		return;   /* something wrong. */
421: 	}
422: 
423: 	// data sanity check.
424: 	if(ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_in_idx == ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_out_idx)
425: 	{
426: 		// queue empty.
427: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "%s error @%d, indx=%d!\r\n", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, 
428: 			ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_in_idx);
429: 		
430: 		return;   /* something wrong. */
431: 	}
432: 
433: 	u16  tx_idx = ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_out_idx;
434: 	
435: 	mb_ipc_cmd_t * queue_cmd = &ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue[tx_idx];
436: 
437: 	// data sanity check.
438: 	if( (((queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param1 ^ ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1) & IPC_PARAM1_MASK) != 0)
439: 		|| (queue_cmd->hdr.cmd != ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd)
440: 		#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
441: 		|| (queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param2 != ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2)
442: 		|| (queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param3 != ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3) 
443: 		#endif
444: 		) /* param1, other fields not compared. */
445: 	{
446: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "%s tx2 error @%d! %x != %x.\r\n", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, 
447: 			queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param1, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1);
448: 
449: 		#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
450: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "tx2 error: ipc-cmd-%02x, %x != %x.\r\n", ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd, 
451: 			queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param2, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2);
452: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "tx2 error: que-cmd-%02x, %x != %x.\r\n", queue_cmd->hdr.cmd, 
453: 			queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param3, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3);
454: 		#endif
455: 
456: 		return;   /* something wrong. */ /* not the CMD just sent. */
457: 	}
458: 
459: 	/* remove the first cmd from the queue. */
460: 	tx_idx = (tx_idx + 1) % ARRAY_SIZE(ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue);
461: 	ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_out_idx = tx_idx;
462: 
463: 	#if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
464: 	// it is a forwarded cmd/rsp.
465: 	if( ipc_cmd->src_cpu != CURRENT_CPU )
466: 	{
467: 		if( (ipc_cmd->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) || 
468: 			(ipc_cmd->route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK) )
469: 		{
470: 			BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Fwd failed, cmd %02x, param1=%08x!\r\n", 
471: 				ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1);
472: 		}
473: 
474: 		goto tx_cmpl_isr_next_cmd;
475: 	}
476: 	#endif
477: 
478: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket;
479: 	
480: 	// search the ipc_socket by port;
481: 	ipc_socket = ipc_socket_search_sender(ipc_cmd->src_port, ipc_cmd->dst_cpu, ipc_cmd->dst_port);
482: 
483: 	if(ipc_socket == NULL)
484: 	{
485: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "%s tx error @%d!, cmd-%02x, param1=%08x!\r\n", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, 
486: 			ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1);
487: 
488: 		goto tx_cmpl_isr_next_cmd;
489: 	}
490: 
491: 	ipc_socket_tx_cmpl_handler(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
492: 
493: tx_cmpl_isr_next_cmd:
494: 
495: 	/* refer to <design document> P45 tx_cmpl_isr 3). */
496: 
497: 	if(ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_in_idx == ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_out_idx)
498: 		return;  // no pending cmd in the queue.
499: 
500: 	queue_cmd = &ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue[tx_idx];
501: 
502: 	// send next pending cmd. // refer to <design document> P45 tx_cmpl_isr 3).
503: 	mb_chnl_write(ipc_route_tbl[route_id].log_chnl, &queue_cmd->mb_cmd);
504: 
505: 	return;
506: 
507: }

515: /* src_cpu must be CURRENT_CPU. */
516: static mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket_search_sender(u8 src_port, u8 dst_cpu, u8 dst_port)
517: {
518: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket = NULL;
519: 	
520: 	if( IS_SERVER_PORT(src_port) )
521: 	{
522: 		int svr_idx = src_port - SERVER_PORT_MIN;
523: 		
524: 		for(int i = 0; i < MAX_CONNET_PER_SVR; i++)
525: 		{
526: 			if(ipc_server_socket_tbl[svr_idx][i].dst_port != dst_port)
527: 				continue;
528: 			if(ipc_server_socket_tbl[svr_idx][i].dst_cpu != dst_cpu)
529: 				continue;
530: 
531: 			ipc_socket = &ipc_server_socket_tbl[svr_idx][i];

699: static int ipc_socket_local_tx_cmd(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd);
700: static int ipc_socket_local_tx_rsp(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd);
701: 
702: /*
703:  * because ipc_cmd is a pointer, 
704:  * it may pending in the tx_queue, 
705:  * so the memory ipc_cmd pointed must **NOT** be in stack (temporary memory).
706:  * 
707:  */
708: static int ipc_socket_tx_rsp(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd)
709: {
710: 	if(ipc_socket->dst_cpu == ipc_socket->src_cpu)
711: 	{
712: 		return ipc_socket_local_tx_rsp(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
713: 	}
714: 	
715: 	u32               temp;
716: 	mb_ipc_route_t  * ipc_route = ipc_router_search_route(ipc_socket->dst_cpu, &temp);
717: 
718: 	if(ipc_route == NULL)
719: 	{
720: 		// no route for this destination cpu.
721: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNREACHABLE;
722: 	}
723: 
724: 	ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd |= MB_IPC_RSP_FLAG;   // set to rsp packet.
725: 	
726: 	ipc_socket_set_addr(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
727: 
728: 	uint32_t flags = rtos_disable_int();
729: 	
730: 	int route_status = ipc_router_send(ipc_route, ipc_cmd);
731: 
732: 	if(route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK)
733: 	{
734: 		ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS;  // clear rx_in_process.
735: 	}
736: 
737: 	rtos_enable_int(flags);
738: 
739: 	return route_status;
740: }
741: 
742: /*
743:  * because ipc_cmd is a pointer, 
744:  * it may pending in the tx_queue, 
745:  * so the memory ipc_cmd pointed must **NOT** be in stack (temporary memory).
746:  * 
747:  */
748: static int ipc_socket_tx_cmd(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd, u32 retry)
749: {
750: 	if(retry == 0)
751: 	{
752: 		ipc_socket->tx_tag++;
753: 	}
754: 	ipc_cmd->tag = ipc_socket->tx_tag;
755: 	
756: 	if(ipc_socket->dst_cpu == ipc_socket->src_cpu)
757: 	{
758: 		return ipc_socket_local_tx_cmd(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
759: 	}
760: 	
761: 	u32               temp;
762: 	mb_ipc_route_t  * ipc_route = ipc_router_search_route(ipc_socket->dst_cpu, &temp);
763: 
764: 	if(ipc_route == NULL)
765: 	{
766: 		// no route for this destination cpu.
767: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNREACHABLE;
768: 	}
769: 
770: 	ipc_socket_set_addr(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
771: 
772: 	uint32_t flags = rtos_disable_int();
773: 	
774: 	int route_status = ipc_router_send(ipc_route, ipc_cmd);
775: 
776: 	if(route_status == IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK)
777: 	{
778: 		ipc_socket->run_state |= STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS;
779: 	}
780: 
781: 	rtos_enable_int(flags);
782: 
783: 	return route_status;
784: }

807: static void ipc_socket_tx_cmpl_handler(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t * ipc_cmd)
808: {
809: 	// if it is a rsp.
810: 	/* refer to <design document> P44 tx_cmpl_isr 1). */
811: 	if( ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd & MB_IPC_RSP_FLAG )
812: 	{
813: 		if( (ipc_cmd->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) || 
814: 			(ipc_cmd->route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK) )
815: 		{
816: 			BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Rsp failed, cmd %02x, param1=%08x!\r\n", 
817: 				ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1);
818: 		}
819: 
820: 		// completed the rx-process, so clear the flag.
821: 		ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS;  // clear rx_in_process.
822: 
823: 		if(ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd == (MB_IPC_RSP_FLAG | MB_IPC_DISCONNECT_CMD)) // disconnect rsp send ok.
824: 		{
825: 			ipc_socket->dst_cpu  = 0;
826: 			ipc_socket->dst_port = 0;  // clear the connection.
827: 		}
828: 		
829: 		return;
830: 	}
831: 
832: 	// it is a cmd.
833: 
834: 	// queue_cmd points to the tx_cmd, ipc_cmd must match the current state of tx_cmd.
835: 	mb_ipc_cmd_t * queue_cmd = &ipc_socket->tx_cmd;
836: 
837: 	// data sanity check.
838: 	if( (((queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param1 ^ ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1) & IPC_PARAM1_MASK) != 0)
839: 		|| (queue_cmd->hdr.cmd != ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd)
840: 		#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
841: 		|| (queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param2 != ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2)
842: 		|| (queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param3 != ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3) 
843: 		#endif
844: 		) /* param1, other fields not compared. */
845: 	{
846: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "%s tx2 error @%d! %x != %x.\r\n", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, 
847: 			queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param1, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1);
848: 
849: 		#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
850: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "tx2 error: ipc-cmd-%02x, %x != %x.\r\n", ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd, 
851: 			queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param2, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2);
852: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "tx2 error: que-cmd-%02x, %x != %x.\r\n", queue_cmd->hdr.cmd, 
853: 			queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param3, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3);
854: 		#endif
855: 
856: 		return;   /* something wrong. */ /* not the CMD just sent. */
857: 	}
858: 	
859: 	// if send failed.
860: 	/* refer to <design document> P44 tx_cmpl_isr 2). */
861: 	if( (ipc_cmd->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) || 
862: 		(ipc_cmd->route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK) )
863: 	{
864: 
865: 		if(ipc_cmd->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
866: 		{
867: 			// mailbox channel tx failed. 
868: 			ipc_socket->tx_status = MB_IPC_TX_FAILED;
869: 		}
870: 		else  // (ipc_cmd->route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK)
871: 		{
872: 			// router failed.
873: 			ipc_socket->tx_status = MB_IPC_ROUTE_BASE_FAILED + ipc_cmd->route_status;
874: 		}
875: 
876: 		ipc_socket_tx_cmpl_notify(ipc_socket);
877: 
878: 		return;
879: 	}
880: 
881: }

883: static int ipc_socket_rx_rsp_handler(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd)
884: {
885: 	if(ipc_socket == NULL)
886: 	{
887: 		// no connection for this rsp.
888: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNREACHABLE;
889: 	}
890: 
891: 	if( (ipc_socket->run_state & STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS) == 0 )	/* unsolicited ipc response. */
892: 	{
893: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNSOLICITED_RSP;
894: 	}
895: 
896: 	if(ipc_socket->tx_tag != ipc_cmd->tag)
897: 	{
898: 		/* un-matched response. */
899: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNMATCHED_RSP;
900: 	}
901: 
902: 	if(ipc_socket->tx_cmd.hdr.cmd != (ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd & MB_IPC_CMD_MASK))
903: 	{
904: 		/* un-matched response. */
905: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNMATCHED_RSP;
906: 	}
907: 
908: 	// data sanity check.
909: 	if( (ipc_socket->tx_cmd.tag != ipc_cmd->tag)
910: 		#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
911: 		|| (ipc_socket->tx_cmd.mb_cmd.param2 != ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2)
912: 		|| (ipc_socket->tx_cmd.mb_cmd.param3 != ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3) 
913: 		#endif
914: 		) /* param1, other fields not compared. */
915: 	{
916: 		#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
917: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "%s error @%d, %d != %d.\r\n", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, 
918: 			ipc_socket->tx_cmd.tag, ipc_cmd->tag);
919: 		#endif
920: 
921: 		/* not the response for the CMD just sent. */
922: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNMATCHED_RSP;
923: 	}
924: 
925: 	#if 0   // can't clear connection here, becasue tx_cmpl_isr will use this connection again.
926: 	        // if there is direct connection between 2 cores, rsp will arrive ahead of cmd-tx_cmpl_isr.
927: 	if(ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd == (MB_IPC_RSP_FLAG | MB_IPC_DISCONNECT_CMD)) // disconnected.
928: 	{
929: 		// it must have been disconnected in the peer side.
930: 		ipc_socket->dst_cpu  = 0;
931: 		ipc_socket->dst_port = 0;  // clear the connection.
932: 	}
933: 	#endif
934: 
935: 	/* save cmd return-status, tx is completed. */
936: 	if(ipc_cmd->api_impl_status != IPC_API_IMPL_STATUS_OK)
937: 		ipc_socket->tx_status = MB_IPC_API_BASE_FAILED + ipc_cmd->api_impl_status;
938: 	else
939: 		ipc_socket->tx_status = MB_IPC_TX_OK;
940: 
941: 	ipc_socket_tx_cmpl_notify(ipc_socket);
942: 
943: 	return IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK;  // this status return is worthless but for debug.
944: }

953: // connect command handler, it is handled internally.
954: static int ipc_socket_rx_cmd_connect(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket)
955: {
956: 	ipc_socket->use_flag  |= USE_FLAG_CONNECTED;
957: 	ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS;  // must have no cmd in sending, clear tx_in_process to be sure. 
958: 	ipc_socket->tx_status = 0;  // must have no cmd in sending, so clear the tx status too.
959: 
960: 	ipc_socket_tx_rsp(ipc_socket, &ipc_socket->rx_cmd);
961: 
962: 	return -1;  // don't notify upper layer for further process.
963: }
964: 
965: // disconnect command handler, it is handled internally.
966: static int ipc_socket_rx_cmd_disconnect(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket)
967: {
968: 	if( (ipc_socket->run_state & STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS) != 0 )
969: 	{
970: 		ipc_socket->tx_status = MB_IPC_DISCONNECTED;
971: 
972: 		/* tx may be failed. disconnect notification. */
973: 		ipc_socket_tx_cmpl_notify(ipc_socket);
974: 	}
975: 
976: 	ipc_socket->use_flag  &= ~USE_FLAG_CONNECTED;
977: 	ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS;    // cleared TX_IN_PROCESS.
978: 
979: 	ipc_socket_tx_rsp(ipc_socket, &ipc_socket->rx_cmd);
980: 
981: 	if(IS_CLIENT_PORT(ipc_socket->src_port))
982: 	{
983: 	//	ipc_socket_rx_notify(ipc_socket);
984: 		return 0;  // need to notify upper layer for further process.
985: 		// if it is a client, notify app to close socket to free resources.
986: 		// server must NOT close socket. it will wait for new connection.
987: 	}
988: 	
989: 	return -1;  // don't notify upper layer for further process.
990: 
991: }

1009: 		return -1;  // need not to notify upper layer.
1010: 	}
1011: 	
1012: //	ipc_socket_rx_notify(ipc_socket);
1013: 
1014: 	return 0;  // need to notify upper layer for further process.
1015: }

1017: static int ipc_socket_rx_cmd_handler(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd)
1018: {
1019: 	if(ipc_socket == NULL)
1020: 	{
1021: 		if(ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd == MB_IPC_CONNECT_CMD)  // it is a connect cmd, not includes the connect response.
1022: 		{
1023: 			// try to establish the connection.
1024: 			u32 temp = mb_ipc_enter_critical();
1025: 			ipc_socket = ipc_socket_server_accept(ipc_cmd->dst_port, ipc_cmd->src_cpu, ipc_cmd->src_port);
1026: 			mb_ipc_exit_critical(temp);
1027: 			if(ipc_socket == NULL)
1028: 			{
1029: 				// no connection for this cmd.
1030: 				return IPC_ROUTE_UNREACHABLE;
1031: 			}
1032: 		}
1033: 		else
1034: 		{
1035: 			// no connection for this cmd.
1036: 			return IPC_ROUTE_UNREACHABLE;
1037: 		}
1038: 	}
1039: 
1040: 	int route_status = IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK;  // return to indicate that cmd has reached target. 
1041: 
1042: 	if( ipc_socket->run_state & STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS )	/* has a cmd uncompleted. */
1043: 	{
1044: 		ipc_cmd->api_impl_status = IPC_API_IMPL_RX_BUSY;
1045: 
1046: 		#if 0
1047: 		// send rsp to fail this cmd.
1048: 		ipc_socket_tx_rsp(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
1049: 		      /* can't call ipc_socket_tx_rsp, because ipc_cmd point to stack memory. */
1050: 		#else
1051: 		route_status = IPC_ROUTE_RX_BUSY;
1052: 		     /*             !!! NOTE !!!                     */
1053: 			 /*       no way to report this fail.            */
1054: 		     /* it is a temporary solution to indicate fail. */
1055: 			 /* actually, it is a API layer fail,            */
1056: 			 /* should return fail state in api_impl_status. */
1057: 		#endif
1058: 	}
1059: 	else  /* it is OK to receive the cmd. */
1060: 	{
1061: 		// save the cmd for further processing.
1062: 		// memcpy(&ipc_socket->rx_cmd, ipc_cmd, sizeof(mb_ipc_cmd_t));
1063: 		ipc_socket->rx_cmd.mb_cmd.hdr.data = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.hdr.data;
1064: 		ipc_socket->rx_cmd.mb_cmd.param1 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1;
1065: 		ipc_socket->rx_cmd.mb_cmd.param2 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2;
1066: 		ipc_socket->rx_cmd.mb_cmd.param3 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3;
1067: 		
1068: 		ipc_socket->rx_read_offset = 0;
1069: 		ipc_socket->run_state |= STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS;
1070: 
1071: 		if( (ipc_socket->use_flag & USE_FLAG_ALLOCATED) == 0 )  // socket must have been initialized.
1072: 		{
1073: 			ipc_socket_rx_cmd_error_handler(ipc_socket, IPC_API_IMPL_NOT_INITED);
1074: 			
1075: 			return IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK;
1076: 		}
1077: 
1078: 		ipc_socket->rx_cmd.api_impl_status = IPC_API_IMPL_STATUS_OK;  // clear the status before providing to upper layer.
1079: 
1080: 		int  ret_val = 0;
1081: 		
1082: 		/* rx cmd process. */
1083: 		switch(ipc_socket->rx_cmd.hdr.cmd)
1084: 		{
1085: 			case MB_IPC_CONNECT_CMD:
1086: 				ret_val = ipc_socket_rx_cmd_connect(ipc_socket);
1087: 				break;
1088: 
1089: 			case MB_IPC_DISCONNECT_CMD:
1090: 				ret_val = ipc_socket_rx_cmd_disconnect(ipc_socket);
1091: 				break;
1092: 
1093: 			case MB_IPC_SEND_CMD:
1094: 				// no special process, go through to default handler.
1095: 				// break;
1096: 				
1097: 			default:
1098: 				ret_val = ipc_socket_rx_cmd_default_handler(ipc_socket);
1099: 				break;
1100: 		}
1101: 
1102: 		ipc_socket->rx_tag = ipc_socket->rx_cmd.tag;
1103: 
1104: 		if(ret_val == 0)  // need to notify app for further process.
1105: 			ipc_socket_rx_notify(ipc_socket);
1106: 		
1107: 		route_status = IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK;  // return to indicate that cmd has reached target.
1108: 		// must return IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK !!!!
1109: 		// because the communication is ok, the cmd result will be returned in RSP package.
1110: 	}
1111: 
1112: 	return route_status;
1113: }

1116: {
1117: 	/* please refer to <design document> P45 rx_isr 3). */
1118: 	// it is a rsp, processed in API-implementation layer.
1119: 	if(ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd & MB_IPC_RSP_FLAG)  /* ipc rsp from other CPU. */
1120: 	{
1121: 		// this status return is worthless but for debug.
1122: 		return ipc_socket_rx_rsp_handler(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
1123: 	}
1124: 	else   // it is a cmd. 
1125: 	{
1126: 		/* please refer to <design document> P45 rx_isr 4). */
1127: 
1128: 		return ipc_socket_rx_cmd_handler(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
1129: 	}
1130: }

1132: static int ipc_socket_local_tx_cmd(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd)
1133: {
1134: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * tx_ipc_socket = ipc_socket;
1135: 	
1136: 	mb_ipc_cmd_t	  rx_cmd;
1137: 
1138: 	// simulate the mailbox tx and rx process.
1139: 	
1140: 	// simulate local tx, (set tx flag). 
1141: 	// always tx successfully, because target resides in local cpu.
1142: 	ipc_socket->run_state |= STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS;
1143: 
1144: 	ipc_socket_set_addr(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
1145: 
1146: 	// simulate the target rx. 
1147: 	// copy mailbox data from device registers to statck variable.
1148: 	// memcpy(&rx_cmd, ipc_cmd, sizeof(rx_cmd));  // receive the cmd.
1149: 	rx_cmd.mb_cmd.hdr.data = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.hdr.data;
1150: 	rx_cmd.mb_cmd.param1 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1;
1151: 	rx_cmd.mb_cmd.param2 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2;
1152: 	rx_cmd.mb_cmd.param3 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3;
1153: 
1154: 	ipc_cmd = &rx_cmd;
1155: 
1156: 	// find the ipc_socket connection for the cmd.
1157: 	ipc_socket = ipc_socket_search_recver(ipc_cmd->dst_port, ipc_cmd->src_cpu, ipc_cmd->src_port);
1158: 
1159: 	ipc_cmd->route_status = ipc_socket_rx_cmd_handler(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
1160: 
1161: 	// simulate the local tx complete.
1162: 	ipc_socket_tx_cmpl_handler(tx_ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
1163: 
1164: 	// always return tx success, cmd fail is handled in cmd tx_cmpl_handler.
1165: 	return IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK;
1166: }

1168: static int ipc_socket_local_tx_rsp(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd)
1169: {
1170: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * tx_ipc_socket = ipc_socket;
1171: 	
1172: 	mb_ipc_cmd_t	  rx_cmd;
1173: 
1174: 	// simulate the mailbox tx and rx process.
1175: 
1176: 	ipc_socket_set_addr(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
1177: 
1178: 	ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd |= MB_IPC_RSP_FLAG;   // set to rsp packet.
1179: 	
1180: 	// simulate the target rx. 
1181: 	// copy mailbox data from device registers to statck variable.
1182: 	// memcpy(&rx_cmd, ipc_cmd, sizeof(rx_cmd));  // receive the rsp.
1183: 	rx_cmd.mb_cmd.hdr.data = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.hdr.data;
1184: 	rx_cmd.mb_cmd.param1 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1;
1185: 	rx_cmd.mb_cmd.param2 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2;
1186: 	rx_cmd.mb_cmd.param3 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3;
1187: 
1188: 	ipc_cmd = &rx_cmd;
1189: 
1190: 	// find the ipc_socket connection for the rsp.
1191: 	ipc_socket = ipc_socket_search_recver(ipc_cmd->dst_port, ipc_cmd->src_cpu, ipc_cmd->src_port);
1192: 
1193: 	// must clear this flag before call peer side rx_rsp_handler.
1194: 	// because, perr side app may send another cmd immediately as soon as tx_in_process is cleared.
1195: 	// if not clear rx_in_process in this side in advances, peer side task may send fail.
1196: 	// tx_ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS;  // clear rx_in_process.
1197: 
1198: 	// simulate the local tx complete. (will clear STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS in this function)
1199: 	ipc_socket_tx_cmpl_handler(tx_ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
1200: 
1201: 	ipc_cmd->route_status = ipc_socket_rx_rsp_handler(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
1202: 	// (ipc_cmd->route_status) this status return is worthless but for debug.
1203: 	// so can clear STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS of tx_ipc_socket->run_state in advance.
1204: 
1205: 	// always return tx success, other fails are handled in tx_cmpl_handler.
1206: 	return IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK;
1207: }

1348: u32 mb_ipc_socket(u8 port, void * rx_callback)
1349: {
1350: 	mb_ipc_socket_handle_t   ipc_handle;
1351: 
1352: 	ipc_handle.data = 0;
1353: 
1354: 	int   port_idx = 0;
1355: 
1356: 	beken_semaphore_t  tx_semaphore = NULL;
1357: 	beken_semaphore_t  rx_semaphore = NULL;
1358: 
1359: 	rtos_init_semaphore(&tx_semaphore, 1);
1360: 	
1361: 	if(tx_semaphore == NULL)
1362: 	{
1363: 		return ipc_handle.data;
1364: 	}
1365: 
1366: 	if(rx_callback == NULL)  // not callback notification
1367: 	{
1368: 		rtos_init_semaphore(&rx_semaphore, 1);
1369: 		
1370: 		if(rx_semaphore == NULL)
1371: 		{
1372: 			rtos_deinit_semaphore(&tx_semaphore);
1373: 			
1374: 			return ipc_handle.data;
1375: 		}
1376: 	}
1377: 
1378: 	u32   temp = mb_ipc_enter_critical();
1379: 	
1380: 	port = ipc_allocate_port(port);
1381: 
1382: 	if(port == 0)
1383: 	{
1384: 		mb_ipc_exit_critical(temp);
1385: 
1386: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&tx_semaphore);
1387: 		if(rx_semaphore != NULL)
1388: 		{
1389: 			rtos_deinit_semaphore(&rx_semaphore);
1390: 		}
1391: 
1392: 		return ipc_handle.data;
1393: 	}
1394: 
1395: 	if( IS_CLIENT_PORT(port) )
1396: 	{
1397: 		port_idx = port - CLIENT_PORT_MIN;
1398: 
1399: 		ipc_client_socket_tbl[port_idx].tx_notify_sema = tx_semaphore;
1400: 
1401: 		if(rx_callback == NULL)
1402: 		{
1403: 			ipc_client_socket_tbl[port_idx].ctrl_mode |= CTRL_RX_SEMA_NOTIFY; // semaphore notification.
1404: 			ipc_client_socket_tbl[port_idx].rx_notify_sema = rx_semaphore;
1405: 		}
1406: 		else
1407: 		{
1408: 			ipc_client_socket_tbl[port_idx].ctrl_mode &= ~CTRL_RX_SEMA_NOTIFY; // callback notification.
1409: 			ipc_client_socket_tbl[port_idx].rx_notify_isr = (mb_ipc_notify_isr_t)rx_callback;
1410: 		}
1411: 		
1412: 		ipc_client_socket_tbl[port_idx].use_flag = USE_FLAG_ALLOCATED;
1413: 		ipc_handle.data = ipc_client_socket_tbl[port_idx].handle.data;
1414: 		
1415: 	}
1416: 	else if( IS_SERVER_PORT(port) )
1417: 	{
1418: 		port_idx = port - SERVER_PORT_MIN;
1419: 		
1420: 		// the same setting for all clients connected to this server.
1421: 		for(int j = 0; j < MAX_CONNET_PER_SVR; j++)
1422: 		{
1423: 			ipc_server_socket_tbl[port_idx][j].tx_notify_sema = tx_semaphore;
1424: 
1425: 			if(rx_callback == NULL)
1426: 			{
1427: 				ipc_server_socket_tbl[port_idx][j].ctrl_mode |= CTRL_RX_SEMA_NOTIFY; // semaphore notification.
1428: 				ipc_server_socket_tbl[port_idx][j].rx_notify_sema = rx_semaphore;
1429: 			}
1430: 			else
1431: 			{
1432: 				ipc_server_socket_tbl[port_idx][j].ctrl_mode &= ~CTRL_RX_SEMA_NOTIFY; // callback notification.
1433: 				ipc_server_socket_tbl[port_idx][j].rx_notify_isr = (mb_ipc_notify_isr_t)rx_callback;
1434: 			}
1435: 			
1436: 			ipc_server_socket_tbl[port_idx][j].use_flag = USE_FLAG_ALLOCATED;
1437: 		}
1438: 		
1439: 		ipc_handle.data = ipc_server_socket_tbl[port_idx][0].handle.data;
1440: 	}
1441: 
1442: 	mb_ipc_exit_critical(temp);
1443: 
1444: 	return ipc_handle.data;
1445: }

1447: #define MB_IPC_RETRY_DELAY		2
1448: #define MB_IPC_RETRY_MAX		1
1449: 
1450: int mb_ipc_connect(u32 handle, u8 dst_cpu, u8 dst_port, u32 time_out)
1451: {
1452: 	// data sanity check.
1453: 	if(IS_NOT_SERVER_PORT(dst_port))
1454: 	{
1455: 		return -MB_IPC_INVALID_PORT;
1456: 	}
1457: 	
1458: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket = get_socket_from_handle(handle);
1459: 
1460: 	if(ipc_socket == NULL)
1461: 	{
1462: 		return -MB_IPC_INVALID_HANDLE;
1463: 	}
1464: 
1465: 	// data sanity check.
1466: 	if( (ipc_socket->use_flag & USE_FLAG_ALLOCATED) == 0 )
1467: 	{
1468: 		return -MB_IPC_NOT_INITED;
1469: 	}
1470: 
1471: 	if(ipc_socket->use_flag & USE_FLAG_CONNECTED)
1472: 	{
1473: 		return -MB_IPC_INVALID_STATE;
1474: 	}
1475: 
1476: 	// set the dst cpu-port firstly, because the tx_cmd/rx_rsp need these informations.
1477: 	ipc_socket->dst_cpu  = dst_cpu;
1478: 	ipc_socket->dst_port = dst_port;
1479: 	
1480: 	ipc_socket->run_state = 0;
1481: 	ipc_socket->tx_status = 0;
1482: 	ipc_socket->rx_read_offset = 0;
1483: 
1484: 	memset(&ipc_socket->tx_cmd, 0, sizeof(ipc_socket->tx_cmd));
1485: 
1486: 	ipc_socket->tx_cmd.hdr.cmd = MB_IPC_CONNECT_CMD;
1487: 
1488: 	u32   retry = 0;
1489: 	int   ret_val = 0;
1490: 
1491: 	do
1492: 	{
1493: 		rtos_get_semaphore(&ipc_socket->tx_notify_sema, 0);  // clear the semaphore state.
1494: 		
1495: 		int route_status = ipc_socket_tx_cmd(ipc_socket, &ipc_socket->tx_cmd, retry);
1496: 		
1497: 		if(route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK)
1498: 		{
1499: 			ret_val = -(MB_IPC_ROUTE_BASE_FAILED + route_status);
1500: 			break;  // not retry for router error.
1501: 		}
1502: 
1503: 		route_status = rtos_get_semaphore(&ipc_socket->tx_notify_sema, time_out);
1504: 		
1505: 		if(route_status != 0)
1506: 		{
1507: 			ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS;  // clear tx_in_process. prevent cmd from being handled in ISR.
1508: 			ret_val = -MB_IPC_TX_TIMEOUT;
1509: 			// rtos_delay_milliseconds(MB_IPC_RETRY_DELAY);
1510: 			continue;
1511: 		}
1512: 		
1513: 		if(ipc_socket->tx_status == MB_IPC_TX_OK)
1514: 		{
1515: 			ipc_socket->use_flag |= USE_FLAG_CONNECTED;
1516: 			return 0;
1517: 		}
1518: 		else
1519: 		{
1520: 			ret_val = -ipc_socket->tx_status;
1521: 			break;  // not retry.
1522: 		}
1523: 
1524: 	} while((ret_val != 0) && (++retry < MB_IPC_RETRY_MAX));
1525: 
1526: 	// if(ret_val != 0)  // must be TRUE.
1527: 	{
1528: 		ipc_socket->dst_cpu  = 0;
1529: 		ipc_socket->dst_port = 0;  // clear the connection.
1530: 	}
1531: 
1532: 	return ret_val;
1533: }
1534: 
1535: int mb_ipc_disconnect(u32 handle, u8 dst_cpu, u8 dst_port, u32 time_out)
1536: {
1537: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket = get_socket_from_handle(handle);
1538: 
1539: 	if(ipc_socket == NULL)
1540: 	{
1541: 		return -MB_IPC_INVALID_HANDLE;
1542: 	}
1543: 
1544: 	// data sanity check.
1545: 	if( (ipc_socket->use_flag & USE_FLAG_ALLOCATED) == 0 )
1546: 	{
1547: 		return -MB_IPC_NOT_INITED;
1548: 	}
1549: 
1550: 	if(dst_port == 0)
1551: 	{
1552: 		ipc_socket->use_flag &= ~USE_FLAG_CONNECTED;
1553: 		return 0;
1554: 	}
1555: 
1556: 	ipc_socket->dst_cpu  = dst_cpu;
1557: 	ipc_socket->dst_port = dst_port;
1558: 	
1559: 	ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS;  // clear tx_in_process. prevent previous cmd from being handled in ISR.
1560: 
1561: 	memset(&ipc_socket->tx_cmd, 0, sizeof(ipc_socket->tx_cmd));
1562: 
1563: 	ipc_socket->tx_cmd.hdr.cmd = MB_IPC_DISCONNECT_CMD;
1564: 
1565: 	u32   retry = 0;
1566: 	int   ret_val = 0;
1567: 
1568: 	do
1569: 	{
1570: 		rtos_get_semaphore(&ipc_socket->tx_notify_sema, 0);  // clear the semaphore state.
1571: 		
1572: 		int route_status = ipc_socket_tx_cmd(ipc_socket, &ipc_socket->tx_cmd, retry);
1573: 		
1574: 		if(route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK)
1575: 		{
1576: 			ret_val = -(MB_IPC_ROUTE_BASE_FAILED + route_status);
1577: 			break;  // not retry for router error.
1578: 		}
1579: 
1580: 		route_status = rtos_get_semaphore(&ipc_socket->tx_notify_sema, time_out);
1581: 		
1582: 		if(route_status != 0)
1583: 		{
1584: 			ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS;  // clear tx_in_process. prevent cmd from being handled in ISR.
1585: 			ret_val = -MB_IPC_TX_TIMEOUT;
1586: 			// rtos_delay_milliseconds(MB_IPC_RETRY_DELAY);
1587: 			continue;
1588: 		}
1589: 
1590: 		if(ipc_socket->dst_port == 0)
1591: 		{
1592: 			ipc_socket->use_flag &= ~USE_FLAG_CONNECTED;
1593: 			return 0;
1594: 		}
1595: 
1596: 		if(ipc_socket->tx_status == MB_IPC_TX_OK)
1597: 		{
1598: 			ipc_socket->dst_cpu  = 0;
1599: 			ipc_socket->dst_port = 0;
1600: 			
1601: 			ipc_socket->use_flag &= ~USE_FLAG_CONNECTED;
1602: 			return 0;
1603: 		}
1604: 		else
1605: 		{
1606: 			if( (ipc_socket->tx_status > MB_IPC_API_BASE_FAILED) || 
1607: 				(ipc_socket->tx_status == (MB_IPC_ROUTE_BASE_FAILED + IPC_ROUTE_UNREACHABLE)) )
1608: 			{
1609: 				ipc_socket->dst_cpu  = 0;
1610: 				ipc_socket->dst_port = 0;
1611: 
1612: 				ipc_socket->use_flag &= ~USE_FLAG_CONNECTED;
1613: 				return 0;
1614: 			}
1615: 			return -ipc_socket->tx_status;  // not retry.
1616: 		}
1617: 	} while((ret_val != 0) && (++retry < MB_IPC_RETRY_MAX));
1618: 
1619: 	return ret_val;

125: static void ipc_cmd_rx_isr(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
126: {
127: 	u32		result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
128: 	mb_chnl_ack_t * ack_buf = (mb_chnl_ack_t *)cmd_buf;
129: 	ipc_cmd_t     * ipc_cmd = (ipc_cmd_t *)cmd_buf;
130: 
131: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == ipc_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
132: 
133: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd & IPC_RSP_CMD_FLAG)  /* ipc rsp from other CPU. */
134: 	{
135: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process == 0)	/* unsolicited ipc response. */
136: 		{
137: 			goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
138: 		}
139: 
140: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd != (cmd_buf->hdr.cmd & IPC_RSP_CMD_MASK))
141: 		{
142: 			/* un-matched rpc response. */
143: 			goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
144: 		}
145: 
146: 		/* communication ok, function is completed. */
147: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
148: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
149: 
150: 		BK_LOGI(MOD_TAG, "IPC_RSP_CMD: %d, %d, %d\r\n", cmd_buf->param1, cmd_buf->param2, cmd_buf->param3);
151: 
152: 		if(ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->rsp_buf))
153: 		{
154: 			/* buffer insufficient, failed. */
155: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
156: 			chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
157: 		}
158: 		else
159: 		{
160: 			/* returns ACK_STATE_COMPLETE, 
161: 			   so must copy data from cmd_buff in case that the buffer is released. */
162: 			if((ipc_cmd->cmd_buff != NULL) && (ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > 0))
163: 			{
164: 				#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
165: 				flush_dcache(ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
166: 				#endif
167: 				
168: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rsp_buf, ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
169: 
170: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len;
171: 			}
172: 			else
173: 			{
174: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
175: 			}
176: 		}
177: 
178: 		rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
179: 
180: 		ipc_rsp_t * ipc_rsp = (ipc_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
181: 
182: 		/* it is a rsp command, nothing need to be returned. */
183: 		ipc_rsp->rsp_buff = NULL;
184: 		ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
185: 
186: 		result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
187: 
188: 		goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
189: 	}
190: 	else
191: 	{
192: 		chnl_cb->rx_cmd = cmd_buf->hdr.cmd;
193: 		chnl_cb->rx_cmd_in_process = 1;
194: 
195: 		BK_LOGD(MOD_TAG, "IPC_CMD: %d, %d, %d\r\n", cmd_buf->param1, cmd_buf->param2, cmd_buf->param3);
196: 
197: 		if(ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->cmd_buf))
198: 		{
199: 			result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
200: 		}
201: 		else
202: 		{
203: 			/* may return ACK_STATE_COMPLETE, 
204: 			   so must copy data from cmd_buff in case that the buffer is released. */
205: 			if((ipc_cmd->cmd_buff != NULL) && (ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > 0))
206: 			{
207: 				#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
208: 				flush_dcache(ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
209: 				#endif
210: 				
211: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->cmd_buf, ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
212: 
213: 				chnl_cb->cmd_len = ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len;
214: 			}
215: 			else
216: 			{
217: 				chnl_cb->cmd_len = 0;
218: 			}
219: 
220: 			result = chnl_cb->rx_cmd_handler(chnl_cb, ack_buf);
221: 		}
222: 
223: 		if(result != ACK_STATE_PENDING)
224: 			chnl_cb->rx_cmd_in_process = 0;
225: 	}

230: 	 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
231: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
232: 	 */
233: 	ack_buf->ack_state = result;

239: static void ipc_cmd_tx_cmpl_isr(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
240: {
241: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.cmd == chnl_cb->tx_cmd)
242: 	{
243: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process == 0)	/* RSP_CMD rx_isr may arrive before this tx_cmpl_isr. */
244: 			return;
245: 
246: 		/* IPC cmd tx complete. */
247: 
248: 		if( (ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) 
249: 			|| (ack_buf->ack_state == ACK_STATE_FAIL) )
250: 		{
251: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
252: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process  = 0;
253: 
254: 			/* communication failed or function failed. */
255: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
256: 		}
257: 		else if(ack_buf->ack_state == ACK_STATE_COMPLETE)
258: 		{
259: 			/* communication ok, function is completed. */
260: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
261: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
262: 
263: 			ipc_rsp_t * ipc_rsp = (ipc_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
264: 
265: 			/* chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == ipc_rsp->rsp_buff. MUST be true. */
266: 
267: 			if(ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->rsp_buf))
268: 			{
269: 				/* buffer insufficient, failed. */
270: 				chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
271: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
272: 			}
273: 			else
274: 			{
275: 				if((ipc_rsp->rsp_buff != NULL) && (ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len > 0))
276: 				{
277: 					#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
278: 					flush_dcache(ipc_rsp->rsp_buff, ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len);;
279: 					#endif
280: 
281: 					memcpy(chnl_cb->rsp_buf, ipc_rsp->rsp_buff, ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len);
282: 					chnl_cb->rsp_len = ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len;
283: 				}
284: 				else
285: 				{
286: 					chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
287: 				}
288: 			}
289: 			
290: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
291: 		}
292: 		else
293: 		{
294: 			/* communication ok, function is pending. */
295: 		}
296: 
297: 		return;
298: 	}
299: 
300: 	/*
301: 	 *   !!!  FAULT  !!!
302: 	 */
303: 	BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Fault in %s,cmd:%d\r\n", __func__, ack_buf->hdr.cmd);
304: 
305: 	return;
306: 
307: }

309: static bk_err_t ipc_chnl_init(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 chnl_id, ipc_rx_cmd_hdlr_t rx_handler)
310: {
311: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
312: 
313: 	if(chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
314: 		return BK_OK;
315: 
316: 	memset(chnl_cb, 0, sizeof(ipc_chnl_cb_t));
317: 	chnl_cb->chnl_id = chnl_id;
318: 
319: 	chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_tx_buff(chnl_id);
320: 	chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_rx_buff(chnl_id);
321: 
322: 	if( (chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) || 
323: 		(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) )
324: 	{
325: 		return BK_FAIL;
326: 	}
327: 
328: 	ret_code = rtos_init_semaphore_adv(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema, 1, 1);
329: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
330: 	{
331: 		return ret_code;
332: 	}
333: 
334: 	ret_code = rtos_init_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema, 1);
335: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
336: 	{
337: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema);
338: 
339: 		return ret_code;
340: 	}
341: 
342: 	ret_code = mb_chnl_open(chnl_id, chnl_cb);
343: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
344: 	{
345: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema);
346: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
347: 
348: 		return ret_code;
349: 	}
350: 
351: 	chnl_cb->rx_cmd_handler = rx_handler;
352: 
353: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR, (void *)ipc_cmd_rx_isr);
354: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR, (void *)ipc_cmd_tx_cmpl_isr);
355: 
356: 	chnl_cb->chnl_inited = 1;
357: 
358: 	return BK_OK;
359: }

361: static bk_err_t ipc_send_cmd(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 cmd, u8 *cmd_buf, u16 cmd_len, u8 * rsp_buf, u16 rsp_buf_len)
362: {
363: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
364: 	ipc_cmd_t	ipc_cmd;
365: 
366: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
367: 		return BK_FAIL;
368: 
369: 	rtos_get_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema, BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER);
370: 
371: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = cmd;
372: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
373: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 1;
374: 
375: 	void * dst_buf = (void *)chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff;
376: 
377: 	do
378: 	{
379: 		if(cmd_len > IPC_XCHG_DATA_MAX)
380: 		{
381: 			ret_val = BK_ERR_PARAM;
382: 			break;
383: 		}
384: 
385: 		if(cmd_buf == NULL)
386: 			cmd_len = 0;
387: 
388: 		if(cmd_len > 0)
389: 			memcpy(dst_buf, cmd_buf, cmd_len);
390: 
391: 		ipc_cmd.chnl_hdr.data = 0;	/* clear hdr. */
392: 		ipc_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = cmd;
393: 		ipc_cmd.cmd_buff      = dst_buf;
394: 		ipc_cmd.cmd_data_len  = cmd_len;
395: 
396: 		ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&ipc_cmd);
397: 		if(ret_val != BK_OK)
398: 		{
399: 			break;
400: 		}
401: 
402: 		ret_val = rtos_get_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema, IPC_RSP_TIMEOUT);  /* isr_callback will set this semaphore. */
403: 		if(ret_val != BK_OK)
404: 		{
405: 			mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_cb->chnl_id, MB_CHNL_TX_RESET, NULL);
406: 			break;
407: 		}
408: 
409: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process  = 0;  /* must have been set to 0 by callback. */
410: 
411: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed)
412: 		{
413: 			ret_val = BK_FAIL;
414: 			break;
415: 		}
416: 
417: 		if((rsp_buf == NULL) || (rsp_buf_len == 0))
418: 		{
419: 			ret_val = BK_OK;
420: 			break;
421: 		}
422: 
423: 		if(rsp_buf_len < chnl_cb->rsp_len)
424: 		{
425: 			ret_val = BK_ERR_PARAM;
426: 			break;
427: 		}
428: 
429: 		if(chnl_cb->rsp_len > 0)
430: 			memcpy(rsp_buf, chnl_cb->rsp_buf, chnl_cb->rsp_len);
431: 
432: 		ret_val = BK_OK;
433: 
434: 	}while(0);
435: 
436: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
437: 
438: 	rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema);
439: 
440: 	return ret_val;
441: 
442: }

504: 	switch(chnl_cb->rx_cmd)

506: 		case IPC_RES_AVAILABLE_INDICATION:

509: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
510: 
511: 				u16  res_id = *((u16 *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf);
512: 
513: 				if(amp_res_available(res_id) == BK_OK)
514: 				{
515: 					result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
516: 				}
517: 				else
518: 				{
519: 					result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
520: 				}
521: 			}
522: 			else
523: 			{
524: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
525: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
526: 			}
527: 			break;
528: 
529: 		case IPC_TEST_CMD:
530: 			if(chnl_cb->cmd_len >= sizeof(u32))
531: 			{
532: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = sizeof(u32);
533: 
534: 				u32 * p_src = (u32 *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
535: 				u32 * p_dst = (u32 *)ipc_rsp->rsp_buff;
536: 
537: 				*p_dst = (*p_src) + 1;
538: 				
539: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
540: 			}
541: 			else
542: 			{
543: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
544: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
545: 			}
546: 			break;
547: 
548: 		case IPC_GET_POWER_SAVE_FLAG:

552: 				u32 * p_dst = (u32 *)ipc_rsp->rsp_buff;

554: 				// return PS flag to caller.

557: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;

559: 			break;
560: 
561: #if (USB_CDC_CP1_IPC)

708: 		case IPC_SET_CPU1_HEART_RATE:
709: 			if(chnl_cb->cmd_len >= sizeof(u32))

721: 			{

723: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;

787: 					result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;

789: 				else
790: 				{
791: 					ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
792: 					result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
793: 				}
794: 			}

943: static int mb_ipc_heartbeat_timeout(void)
944: {
945: 	u32   cur_time;
946: 
947: 	cur_time = (u32)rtos_get_time();
948: 
949: 	if(cpu1_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
950: 	{
951: 		return 0;
952: 	}
953: 	if((cpu1_state == CORE_STARTING) || (cpu1_dump != 0))
954: 	{
955: 		cpu1_heartbeat_timestamp = cur_time;
956: 		return 0;
957: 	}
958: 
959: 	if(cur_time >= cpu1_heartbeat_timestamp)
960: 	{
961: 		cur_time -= cpu1_heartbeat_timestamp;
962: 	}
963: 	else
964: 	{
965: 		cur_time += (~(cpu1_heartbeat_timestamp)) + 1;  // wrap around. 
966: 	}
967: 	
968: 	if(cur_time < CONFIG_INT_WDT_PERIOD_MS)
969: 	{
970: 		cpu1_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
971: 		return 0;
972: 	}
973: 
974: 	return 1;
975: }

977: static void mb_ipc_task( void *para )
978: {
979: 	bk_err_t	ret_val;
980: 	u32    events;
981: 	u32    check_time = BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER;
982: 	
983: 	ret_val = rtos_init_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event);
984: 
985: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
986: 	{
987: 		rtos_delete_thread(NULL);
988: 		return;
989: 	}
990: 
991: 	while(1)
992: 	{
993: 		events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_ALL_FLAGS, true, check_time);
994: 
995: 		if(events == 0)
996: 		{
997: 			// timeout, so check heartbeat.
998: 			events = MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG;
999: 		}
1000: 
1001: 		if(events & MB_IPC_STOP_CORE_FLAG)  // process this event at first!!!!
1002: 		{
1003: 			if(cpu1_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
1004: 			{
1005: 				events = 0;  // clear all events.
1006: 			}
1007: 		}
1008: 		
1009: 		if(events & MB_IPC_START_CORE_FLAG)
1010: 		{
1011: 			u8   retry_cnt = 0;
1012: 
1013: 			while(cpu1_state == CORE_STARTING)
1014: 			{
1015: 				mb_ipc_heartbeat_timeout();
1016: 				
1017: 				if(events & MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG)
1018: 				{
1019: 					if(cpu1_state == CORE_STARTING)
1020: 					{
1021: 						cpu1_state = CORE_POWER_ON;
1022: 						break;  // cpu1 power on. 
1023: 					}
1024: 				}
1025: 				else
1026: 				{
1027: 					if(retry_cnt > 0)
1028: 					{
1029: 						BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "IPC retry to start core1\r\n");
1030: 						stop_cpu1_core();
1031: 						rtos_delay_milliseconds(6);
1032: 						start_cpu1_core();
1033: 						break;
1034: 					}
1035: 					else
1036: 					{
1037: 						events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG, true, 2000);// 2s
1038: 					}
1039: 				}
1040: 
1041: 				retry_cnt++;
1042: 			}
1043: 
1044: 			// discard this event when not in CORE_STARTING state.
1045: 		}
1046: 		
1047: 		if(events & MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG)
1048: 		{
1049: 			if(mb_ipc_heartbeat_timeout())
1050: 			{
1051: 				BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "IPC restart core1\r\n");
1052: 				stop_cpu1_core();
1053: 				rtos_delay_milliseconds(6);
1054: 				start_cpu1_core();
1055: 			}
1056: 		}
1057: 
1058: 		if(cpu1_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
1059: 		{
1060: 			check_time = BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER;
1061: 		}
1062: 		else
1063: 		{
1064: 			check_time = CONFIG_INT_WDT_PERIOD_MS;
1065: 		}
1066: 	}
1067: }

30: enum {
31: 	/* The host should never send HCI_Reset */
32: 	BT_QUIRK_NO_RESET = BIT(0),
33: 	/* The controller does not auto-initiate a DLE procedure when the
34: 	 * initial connection data length parameters are not equal to the
35: 	 * default data length parameters. Therefore the host should initiate
36: 	 * the DLE procedure after connection establishment. */
37: 	BT_QUIRK_NO_AUTO_DLE = BIT(1),
38: };
39: 
40: #define IS_BT_QUIRK_NO_AUTO_DLE(bt_dev) ((bt_dev)->drv->quirks & BT_QUIRK_NO_AUTO_DLE)
41: 
42: /* @brief The HCI event shall be given to bt_recv_prio */
43: #define BT_HCI_EVT_FLAG_RECV_PRIO BIT(0)
44: /* @brief  The HCI event shall be given to bt_recv. */
45: #define BT_HCI_EVT_FLAG_RECV      BIT(1)
46: 
47: /** @brief Get HCI event flags.
48:  *
49:  * Helper for the HCI driver to get HCI event flags that describes rules that.
50:  * must be followed.
51:  *
52:  * When CONFIG_BT_RECV_IS_RX_THREAD is enabled the flags
53:  * BT_HCI_EVT_FLAG_RECV and BT_HCI_EVT_FLAG_RECV_PRIO indicates if the event
54:  * should be given to bt_recv or bt_recv_prio.
55:  *
56:  * @param evt HCI event code.
57:  *
58:  * @return HCI event flags for the specified event.
59:  */
60: static inline uint8_t bt_hci_evt_get_flags(uint8_t evt)
61: {
62: 	switch (evt) {
63: 	case BT_HCI_EVT_DISCONN_COMPLETE:
64: 		return BT_HCI_EVT_FLAG_RECV | BT_HCI_EVT_FLAG_RECV_PRIO;
65: 		/* fallthrough */
66: #if defined(CONFIG_BT_CONN) || defined(CONFIG_BT_ISO)
67: 	case BT_HCI_EVT_NUM_COMPLETED_PACKETS:
68: #if defined(CONFIG_BT_CONN)
69: 	case BT_HCI_EVT_DATA_BUF_OVERFLOW:
70: 		__fallthrough;
71: #endif /* defined(CONFIG_BT_CONN) */
72: #endif /* CONFIG_BT_CONN ||  CONFIG_BT_ISO */
73: 	case BT_HCI_EVT_CMD_COMPLETE:
74: 	case BT_HCI_EVT_CMD_STATUS:
75: 		return BT_HCI_EVT_FLAG_RECV_PRIO;
76: 	default:
77: 		return BT_HCI_EVT_FLAG_RECV;
78: 	}
79: }

86:  * set with the help of bt_buf_set_type() before calling this API.
87:  *
88:  * When CONFIG_BT_RECV_IS_RX_THREAD is defined then this API should not be used
89:  * for so-called high priority HCI events, which should instead be delivered to
90:  * the host stack through bt_recv_prio().
91:  *
92:  * @param buf Network buffer containing data from the controller.
93:  *
94:  * @return 0 on success or negative error number on failure.
95:  */

103:  * bt_hci_evt_get_flags() helper that can be used to identify which events
104:  * have the BT_HCI_EVT_FLAG_RECV_PRIO flag set.
105:  *
106:  * As with bt_recv(), the buffer needs to have its type set with the help of
107:  * bt_buf_set_type() before calling this API. The only exception is so called

13: #include <drivers/bluetooth/hci_driver.h>
14: #include <bluetooth/buf.h>
15: #include <bluetooth/hci_raw.h>

18: #define BT_DBG_ENABLED IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_DEBUG_HCI_CORE)
19: #define LOG_MODULE_NAME bt_hci_raw

27: #define H4_ACL 0x02
28: #define H4_SCO 0x03
29: #define H4_EVT 0x04
30: #define H4_ISO 0x05
31: 
32: static struct k_fifo *raw_rx;
33: 
34: #if defined(CONFIG_BT_HCI_RAW_H4_ENABLE)
35: static uint8_t raw_mode = BT_HCI_RAW_MODE_H4;
36: #else
37: static uint8_t raw_mode;
38: #endif
39: 
40: #define BT_BUF_RX_COUNT MAX(CONFIG_BT_BUF_EVT_RX_COUNT, CONFIG_BT_BUF_ACL_RX_COUNT)
41: NET_BUF_POOL_FIXED_DEFINE(hci_rx_pool, BT_BUF_RX_COUNT,
42: 			  BT_BUF_RX_SIZE, NULL);
43: NET_BUF_POOL_FIXED_DEFINE(hci_cmd_pool, CONFIG_BT_BUF_CMD_TX_COUNT,
44: 			  BT_BUF_CMD_SIZE(CONFIG_BT_BUF_CMD_TX_SIZE), NULL);
45: NET_BUF_POOL_FIXED_DEFINE(hci_acl_pool, CONFIG_BT_BUF_ACL_TX_COUNT,
46: 			  BT_BUF_ACL_SIZE(CONFIG_BT_BUF_ACL_TX_SIZE), NULL);
47: #if defined(CONFIG_BT_ISO)
48: NET_BUF_POOL_FIXED_DEFINE(hci_iso_pool, CONFIG_BT_ISO_TX_BUF_COUNT,
49: 			  CONFIG_BT_ISO_TX_MTU, NULL);
50: #endif /* CONFIG_BT_ISO */
51: 
52: struct bt_dev_raw bt_dev;
53: struct bt_hci_raw_cmd_ext *cmd_ext;
54: static size_t cmd_ext_size;
55: 
56: int bt_hci_driver_register(const struct bt_hci_driver *drv)
57: {
58: 	if (bt_dev.drv) {
59: 		return -EALREADY;
60: 	}
61: 
62: 	if (!drv->open || !drv->send) {
63: 		return -EINVAL;
64: 	}
65: 
66: 	bt_dev.drv = drv;
67: 
68: 	BT_DBG("Registered %s", drv->name ? drv->name : "");
69: 
70: 	bt_monitor_new_index(BT_MONITOR_TYPE_PRIMARY, drv->bus,
71: 			     BT_ADDR_ANY, drv->name ? drv->name : "bt0");
72: 
73: 	return 0;
74: }

76: struct net_buf *bt_buf_get_rx(enum bt_buf_type type, k_timeout_t timeout)
77: {
78: 	struct net_buf *buf;
79: 
80: 	switch (type) {
81: 	case BT_BUF_EVT:
82: 	case BT_BUF_ACL_IN:
83: 	case BT_BUF_ISO_IN:
84: 		break;
85: 	default:
86: 		BT_ERR("Invalid rx type: %u", type);
87: 		return NULL;
88: 	}
89: 
90: 	buf = net_buf_alloc(&hci_rx_pool, timeout);
91: 	if (!buf) {
92: 		return buf;
93: 	}
94: 
95: 	net_buf_reserve(buf, BT_BUF_RESERVE);
96: 	bt_buf_set_type(buf, type);
97: 
98: 	return buf;
99: }
100: 
101: struct net_buf *bt_buf_get_tx(enum bt_buf_type type, k_timeout_t timeout,
102: 			      const void *data, size_t size)
103: {
104: 	struct net_buf_pool *pool;
105: 	struct net_buf *buf;
106: 
107: 	switch (type) {
108: 	case BT_BUF_CMD:
109: 		pool = &hci_cmd_pool;
110: 		break;
111: 	case BT_BUF_ACL_OUT:
112: 		pool = &hci_acl_pool;
113: 		break;
114: #if defined(CONFIG_BT_ISO)
115: 	case BT_BUF_ISO_OUT:
116: 		pool = &hci_iso_pool;
117: 		break;
118: #endif /* CONFIG_BT_ISO */
119: 	case BT_BUF_H4:
120: 		if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_HCI_RAW_H4) &&
121: 		    raw_mode == BT_HCI_RAW_MODE_H4) {
122: 			switch (((uint8_t *)data)[0]) {
123: 			case H4_CMD:
124: 				type = BT_BUF_CMD;
125: 				pool = &hci_cmd_pool;
126: 				break;
127: 			case H4_ACL:
128: 				type = BT_BUF_ACL_OUT;
129: 				pool = &hci_acl_pool;
130: 				break;
131: #if defined(CONFIG_BT_ISO)
132: 			case H4_ISO:
133: 				type = BT_BUF_ISO_OUT;
134: 				pool = &hci_iso_pool;
135: 				break;
136: #endif /* CONFIG_BT_ISO */
137: 			default:
138: 				LOG_ERR("Unknown H4 type %u", type);
139: 				return NULL;
140: 			}
141: 
142: 			/* Adjust data pointer to discard the header */
143: 			data = (uint8_t *)data + 1;
144: 			size--;
145: 			break;
146: 		}
147: 		__fallthrough;
148: 	default:
149: 		BT_ERR("Invalid tx type: %u", type);
150: 		return NULL;
151: 	}
152: 
153: 	buf = net_buf_alloc(pool, timeout);
154: 	if (!buf) {
155: 		return buf;
156: 	}
157: 
158: 	net_buf_reserve(buf, BT_BUF_RESERVE);
159: 	bt_buf_set_type(buf, type);
160: 
161: 	if (data && size) {
162: 		if (net_buf_tailroom(buf) < size) {
163: 			net_buf_unref(buf);
164: 			return NULL;
165: 		}
166: 
167: 		net_buf_add_mem(buf, data, size);
168: 	}
169: 
170: 	return buf;
171: }
172: 
173: struct net_buf *bt_buf_get_cmd_complete(k_timeout_t timeout)
174: {
175: 	return bt_buf_get_rx(BT_BUF_EVT, timeout);
176: }
177: 
178: struct net_buf *bt_buf_get_evt(uint8_t evt, bool discardable, k_timeout_t timeout)
179: {
180: 	return bt_buf_get_rx(BT_BUF_EVT, timeout);
181: }

183: int bt_recv(struct net_buf *buf)
184: {
185: 	BT_DBG("buf %p len %u", buf, buf->len);
186: 
187: 	bt_monitor_send(bt_monitor_opcode(buf), buf->data, buf->len);
188: 
189: 	if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_HCI_RAW_H4) &&
190: 	    raw_mode == BT_HCI_RAW_MODE_H4) {
191: 		switch (bt_buf_get_type(buf)) {
192: 		case BT_BUF_EVT:
193: 			net_buf_push_u8(buf, H4_EVT);
194: 			break;
195: 		case BT_BUF_ACL_IN:
196: 			net_buf_push_u8(buf, H4_ACL);
197: 			break;
198: 		case BT_BUF_ISO_IN:
199: 			if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_ISO)) {
200: 				net_buf_push_u8(buf, H4_ISO);
201: 				break;
202: 			}
203: 			__fallthrough;
204: 		default:
205: 			BT_ERR("Unknown type %u", bt_buf_get_type(buf));
206: 			return -EINVAL;
207: 		}
208: 	}
209: 
210: 	/* Queue to RAW rx queue */
211: 	net_buf_put(raw_rx, buf);
212: 
213: 	return 0;
214: }
215: 
216: int bt_recv_prio(struct net_buf *buf)
217: {
218: 	if (bt_buf_get_type(buf) == BT_BUF_EVT) {
219: 		struct bt_hci_evt_hdr *hdr = (void *)buf->data;
220: 		uint8_t evt_flags = bt_hci_evt_get_flags(hdr->evt);
221: 
222: 		if ((evt_flags & BT_HCI_EVT_FLAG_RECV_PRIO) &&
223: 		    (evt_flags & BT_HCI_EVT_FLAG_RECV)) {
224: 			/* Avoid queuing the event twice */
225: 			return 0;
226: 		}
227: 	}
228: 
229: 	return bt_recv(buf);
230: }
231: 
232: static void bt_cmd_complete_ext(uint16_t op, uint8_t status)
233: {
234: 	struct net_buf *buf;
235: 	struct bt_hci_evt_cc_status *cc;
236: 
237: 	if (status == BT_HCI_ERR_EXT_HANDLED) {
238: 		return;
239: 	}
240: 
241: 	buf = bt_hci_cmd_complete_create(op, sizeof(*cc));
242: 	cc = net_buf_add(buf, sizeof(*cc));
243: 	cc->status = status;
244: 
245: 	bt_recv(buf);
246: }
247: 
248: static uint8_t bt_send_ext(struct net_buf *buf)
249: {
250: 	struct bt_hci_cmd_hdr *hdr;
251: 	struct net_buf_simple_state state;
252: 	int i;
253: 	uint16_t op;
254: 	uint8_t status;
255: 
256: 	status = BT_HCI_ERR_SUCCESS;
257: 
258: 	if (!cmd_ext) {
259: 		return status;
260: 	}
261: 
262: 	net_buf_simple_save(&buf->b, &state);
263: 
264: 	if (buf->len < sizeof(*hdr)) {
265: 		BT_ERR("No HCI Command header");
266: 		return BT_HCI_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
267: 	}
268: 
269: 	hdr = net_buf_pull_mem(buf, sizeof(*hdr));
270: 	if (buf->len < hdr->param_len) {
271: 		BT_ERR("Invalid HCI CMD packet length");
272: 		return BT_HCI_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
273: 	}
274: 
275: 	op = sys_le16_to_cpu(hdr->opcode);
276: 
277: 	for (i = 0; i < cmd_ext_size; i++) {
278: 		struct bt_hci_raw_cmd_ext *cmd = &cmd_ext[i];
279: 
280: 		if (cmd->op == op) {
281: 			if (buf->len < cmd->min_len) {
282: 				status = BT_HCI_ERR_INVALID_PARAM;
283: 			} else {
284: 				status = cmd->func(buf);
285: 			}
286: 
287: 			break;
288: 		}
289: 	}
290: 
291: 	if (status) {
292: 		bt_cmd_complete_ext(op, status);
293: 		return status;
294: 	}
295: 
296: 	net_buf_simple_restore(&buf->b, &state);
297: 
298: 	return status;
299: }
300: 
301: int bt_send(struct net_buf *buf)
302: {
303: 	BT_DBG("buf %p len %u", buf, buf->len);
304: 
305: 	bt_monitor_send(bt_monitor_opcode(buf), buf->data, buf->len);
306: 
307: 	if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_HCI_RAW_CMD_EXT) &&
308: 	    bt_buf_get_type(buf) == BT_BUF_CMD) {
309: 		uint8_t status;
310: 
311: 		status = bt_send_ext(buf);
312: 		if (status) {
313: 			return status;
314: 		}
315: 	}
316: 
317: 	if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_TINYCRYPT_ECC)) {
318: 		return bt_hci_ecc_send(buf);
319: 	}
320: 
321: 	return bt_dev.drv->send(buf);
322: }
323: 
324: int bt_hci_raw_set_mode(uint8_t mode)
325: {
326: 	BT_DBG("mode %u", mode);
327: 
328: 	if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_HCI_RAW_H4)) {
329: 		switch (mode) {
330: 		case BT_HCI_RAW_MODE_PASSTHROUGH:
331: 		case BT_HCI_RAW_MODE_H4:
332: 			raw_mode = mode;
333: 			return 0;
334: 		}
335: 	}
336: 
337: 	return -EINVAL;
338: }
339: 
340: uint8_t bt_hci_raw_get_mode(void)
341: {
342: 	if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_HCI_RAW_H4)) {
343: 		return raw_mode;
344: 	}
345: 
346: 	return BT_HCI_RAW_MODE_PASSTHROUGH;
347: }
348: 
349: void bt_hci_raw_cmd_ext_register(struct bt_hci_raw_cmd_ext *cmds, size_t size)
350: {
351: 	if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_HCI_RAW_CMD_EXT)) {
352: 		cmd_ext = cmds;
353: 		cmd_ext_size = size;
354: 	}
355: }

357: int bt_enable_raw(struct k_fifo *rx_queue)
358: {
359: 	const struct bt_hci_driver *drv = bt_dev.drv;
360: 	int err;
361: 
362: 	BT_DBG("");
363: 
364: 	raw_rx = rx_queue;
365: 
366: 	if (!bt_dev.drv) {
367: 		BT_ERR("No HCI driver registered");
368: 		return -ENODEV;
369: 	}
370: 
371: 	if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_TINYCRYPT_ECC)) {
372: 		bt_hci_ecc_init();
373: 	}

377: 		BT_ERR("HCI driver open failed (%d)", err);

383: 	return 0;

288: int bt_hci_cmd_send_sync(uint16_t opcode, struct net_buf *buf,
289: 			 struct net_buf **rsp)
290: {
291: 	struct k_sem sync_sem;
292: 	uint8_t status;
293: 	int err;
294: 
295: 	if (!buf) {
296: 		buf = bt_hci_cmd_create(opcode, 0);
297: 		if (!buf) {
298: 			return -ENOBUFS;
299: 		}
300: 	}
301: 
302: 	BT_VER("buf %p opcode 0x%04x len %u", buf, opcode, buf->len);
303: 
304: 	k_sem_init(&sync_sem, 0, 1);
305: 	cmd(buf)->sync = &sync_sem;
306: 
307: 	/* Make sure the buffer stays around until the command completes */
308: 	net_buf_put(&bt_dev.cmd_tx_queue, net_buf_ref(buf));
309: 
310: 	err = k_sem_take(&sync_sem, HCI_CMD_TIMEOUT);
311: 	BT_ASSERT_MSG(err == 0, "k_sem_take failed with err %d", err);
312: 
313: 	status = cmd(buf)->status;
314: 	if (status) {
315: 		BT_WARN("opcode 0x%04x status 0x%02x", opcode, status);
316: 		net_buf_unref(buf);
317: 
318: 		switch (status) {
319: 		case BT_HCI_ERR_CONN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED:
320: 			return -ECONNREFUSED;
321: 		default:
322: 			return -EIO;
323: 		}
324: 	}
325: 
326: 	BT_VER("rsp %p opcode 0x%04x len %u", buf, opcode, buf->len);
327: 
328: 	if (rsp) {
329: 		*rsp = buf;
330: 	} else {
331: 		net_buf_unref(buf);
332: 	}
333: 
334: 	return 0;
335: }

372: static void hci_num_completed_packets(struct net_buf *buf)
373: {
374: 	struct bt_hci_evt_num_completed_packets *evt = (void *)buf->data;
375: 	int i;
376: 
377: 	BT_DBG("num_handles %u", evt->num_handles);
378: 
379: 	for (i = 0; i < evt->num_handles; i++) {
380: 		uint16_t handle, count;
381: 		struct bt_conn *conn;
382: 
383: 		handle = sys_le16_to_cpu(evt->h[i].handle);
384: 		count = sys_le16_to_cpu(evt->h[i].count);
385: 
386: 		BT_DBG("handle %u count %u", handle, count);
387: 
388: 		conn = bt_conn_lookup_handle(handle);
389: 		if (!conn) {
390: 			BT_ERR("No connection for handle %u", handle);
391: 			continue;
392: 		}
393: 
394: 		while (count--) {
395: 			struct bt_conn_tx *tx;
396: 			sys_snode_t *node;
397: 			unsigned int key;
398: 
399: 			key = irq_lock();
400: 
401: 			if (conn->pending_no_cb) {
402: 				conn->pending_no_cb--;
403: 				irq_unlock(key);
404: 				k_sem_give(bt_conn_get_pkts(conn));
405: 				continue;
406: 			}
407: 
408: 			node = sys_slist_get(&conn->tx_pending);
409: 			irq_unlock(key);
410: 
411: 			if (!node) {
412: 				BT_ERR("packets count mismatch");
413: 				break;
414: 			}
415: 
416: 			tx = CONTAINER_OF(node, struct bt_conn_tx, node);
417: 
418: 			key = irq_lock();
419: 			conn->pending_no_cb = tx->pending_no_cb;
420: 			tx->pending_no_cb = 0U;
421: 			sys_slist_append(&conn->tx_complete, &tx->node);
422: 			irq_unlock(key);
423: 
424: 			k_work_submit(&conn->tx_complete_work);
425: 			k_sem_give(bt_conn_get_pkts(conn));
426: 		}
427: 
428: 		bt_conn_unref(conn);
429: 	}

538: 			/* Host resolving is used, use the RPA directly. */
539: 			peer_addr = &conn->le.resp_addr;
540: 		}
541: #endif
542: 		bt_addr_le_copy(&cp->peer_addr, peer_addr);
543: 		cp->filter_policy = BT_HCI_LE_CREATE_CONN_FP_NO_FILTER;
544: 	}
545: 
546: 	cp->own_addr_type = own_addr_type;
547: 	cp->phys = 0;
548: 
549: 	if (!(bt_dev.create_param.options & BT_CONN_LE_OPT_NO_1M)) {
550: 		cp->phys |= BT_HCI_LE_EXT_SCAN_PHY_1M;
551: 		phy = net_buf_add(buf, sizeof(*phy));
552: 		phy->scan_interval = sys_cpu_to_le16(
553: 			bt_dev.create_param.interval);
554: 		phy->scan_window = sys_cpu_to_le16(
555: 			bt_dev.create_param.window);
556: 		set_phy_conn_param(conn, phy);
557: 	}
558: 
559: 	if (bt_dev.create_param.options & BT_CONN_LE_OPT_CODED) {
560: 		cp->phys |= BT_HCI_LE_EXT_SCAN_PHY_CODED;
561: 		phy = net_buf_add(buf, sizeof(*phy));
562: 		phy->scan_interval = sys_cpu_to_le16(
563: 			bt_dev.create_param.interval_coded);
564: 		phy->scan_window = sys_cpu_to_le16(
565: 			bt_dev.create_param.window_coded);
566: 		set_phy_conn_param(conn, phy);
567: 	}
568: 
569: 	bt_hci_cmd_state_set_init(buf, &state, bt_dev.flags,
570: 				  BT_DEV_INITIATING, true);
571: 
572: 	return bt_hci_cmd_send_sync(BT_HCI_OP_LE_EXT_CREATE_CONN, buf, NULL);

675: static uint16_t disconnected_handles[CONFIG_BT_MAX_CONN];
676: static void conn_handle_disconnected(uint16_t handle)
677: {
678: 	for (int i = 0; i < ARRAY_SIZE(disconnected_handles); i++) {
679: 		if (!disconnected_handles[i]) {
680: 			/* Use invalid connection handle bits so that connection
681: 			 * handle 0 can be used as a valid non-zero handle.
682: 			 */
683: 			disconnected_handles[i] = ~BT_ACL_HANDLE_MASK | handle;
684: 		}
685: 	}
686: }
687: 
688: static bool conn_handle_is_disconnected(uint16_t handle)
689: {
690: 	handle |= ~BT_ACL_HANDLE_MASK;
691: 
692: 	for (int i = 0; i < ARRAY_SIZE(disconnected_handles); i++) {
693: 		if (disconnected_handles[i] == handle) {
694: 			disconnected_handles[i] = 0;
695: 			return true;
696: 		}
697: 	}
698: 
699: 	return false;
700: }

702: static void hci_disconn_complete_prio(struct net_buf *buf)
703: {
704: 	struct bt_hci_evt_disconn_complete *evt = (void *)buf->data;
705: 	uint16_t handle = sys_le16_to_cpu(evt->handle);
706: 	struct bt_conn *conn;
707: 
708: 	BT_DBG("status 0x%02x handle %u reason 0x%02x", evt->status, handle,evt->reason);
709: 
710: 	if (evt->status) {
711: 		return;
712: 	}
713: 
714: 	conn = bt_conn_lookup_handle(handle);
715: 	if (!conn) {
716: 		/* Priority disconnect complete event received before normal
717: 		 * connection complete event.
718: 		 */
719: 		conn_handle_disconnected(handle);
720: 		return;
721: 	}
722: 
723: 	bt_conn_set_state(conn, BT_CONN_DISCONNECT_COMPLETE);
724: 	bt_conn_unref(conn);
725: }
726: 
727: static void hci_disconn_complete(struct net_buf *buf)
728: {
729: 	struct bt_hci_evt_disconn_complete *evt = (void *)buf->data;
730: 	uint16_t handle = sys_le16_to_cpu(evt->handle);
731: 	struct bt_conn *conn;
732: 
733: 	BT_DBG("status 0x%02x handle %u reason 0x%02x", evt->status, handle,
734: 	       evt->reason);
735: 
736: 	if (evt->status) {
737: 		return;
738: 	}
739: 
740: 	conn = bt_conn_lookup_handle(handle);
741: 	if (!conn) {
742: 		BT_ERR("Unable to look up conn with handle %u", handle);
743: 		return;
744: 	}
745: 
746: 	conn->err = evt->reason;
747: 
748: 	bt_conn_set_state(conn, BT_CONN_DISCONNECTED);
749: 
750: 	if (conn->type != BT_CONN_TYPE_LE) {
751: #if defined(CONFIG_BT_BREDR)
752: 		if (conn->type == BT_CONN_TYPE_SCO) {
753: 			bt_sco_cleanup(conn);
754: 			return;
755: 		}
756: 		/*
757: 		 * If only for one connection session bond was set, clear keys
758: 		 * database row for this connection.
759: 		 */
760: 		if (conn->type == BT_CONN_TYPE_BR &&
761: 		    atomic_test_and_clear_bit(conn->flags, BT_CONN_BR_NOBOND)) {
762: 			bt_keys_link_key_clear(conn->br.link_key);
763: 		}
764: #endif
765: 		bt_conn_unref(conn);
766: 		return;
767: 	}
768: 
769: #if defined(CONFIG_BT_CENTRAL) && !defined(CONFIG_BT_FILTER_ACCEPT_LIST)
770: 	if (atomic_test_bit(conn->flags, BT_CONN_AUTO_CONNECT)) {
771: 		bt_conn_set_state(conn, BT_CONN_CONNECT_SCAN);
772: 		bt_le_scan_update(false);
773: 	}
774: #endif /* defined(CONFIG_BT_CENTRAL) && !defined(CONFIG_BT_FILTER_ACCEPT_LIST) */
775: 
776: 	bt_conn_unref(conn);
777: }

896: static struct bt_conn *find_pending_connect(uint8_t role, bt_addr_le_t *peer_addr)
897: {
898: 	struct bt_conn *conn;
899: 
900: 	/*
901: 	 * Make lookup to check if there's a connection object in
902: 	 * CONNECT or CONNECT_AUTO state associated with passed peer LE address.
903: 	 */
904: 	if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_CENTRAL) && role == BT_HCI_ROLE_CENTRAL) {
905: 		conn = bt_conn_lookup_state_le(BT_ID_DEFAULT, peer_addr,
906: 					       BT_CONN_CONNECT);
907: 		if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_FILTER_ACCEPT_LIST) && !conn) {
908: 			conn = bt_conn_lookup_state_le(BT_ID_DEFAULT,
909: 						       BT_ADDR_LE_NONE,
910: 						       BT_CONN_CONNECT_AUTO);
911: 		}
912: 
913: 		return conn;
914: 	}
915: 
916: 	if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_PERIPHERAL) && role == BT_HCI_ROLE_PERIPHERAL) {
917: 		conn = bt_conn_lookup_state_le(bt_dev.adv_conn_id, peer_addr,
918: 					       BT_CONN_CONNECT_DIR_ADV);
919: 		if (!conn) {
920: 			conn = bt_conn_lookup_state_le(bt_dev.adv_conn_id,
921: 						       BT_ADDR_LE_NONE,
922: 						       BT_CONN_CONNECT_ADV);
923: 		}
924: 
925: 		return conn;
926: 	}
927: 
928: 	return NULL;
929: }

931: static void conn_auto_initiate(struct bt_conn *conn)
932: {
933: 	int err;
934: 
935: 	if (conn->state != BT_CONN_CONNECTED) {
936: 		/* It is possible that connection was disconnected directly from
937: 		 * connected callback so we must check state before doing
938: 		 * connection parameters update.
939: 		 */
940: 		return;
941: 	}
942: 
943: 	if (!atomic_test_bit(conn->flags, BT_CONN_AUTO_FEATURE_EXCH) &&
944: 	    ((conn->role == BT_HCI_ROLE_CENTRAL) ||
945: 	     BT_FEAT_LE_PER_INIT_FEAT_XCHG(bt_dev.le.features))) {
946: 		err = hci_le_read_remote_features(conn);
947: 		if (!err) {
948: 			return;
949: 		}
950: 	}
951: 
952: 	if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_REMOTE_VERSION) &&
953: 	    !atomic_test_bit(conn->flags, BT_CONN_AUTO_VERSION_INFO)) {
954: 		err = hci_read_remote_version(conn);
955: 		if (!err) {
956: 			return;
957: 		}
958: 	}
959: 
960: 	if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_AUTO_PHY_UPDATE) &&
961: 	    !atomic_test_bit(conn->flags, BT_CONN_AUTO_PHY_COMPLETE) &&
962: 	    BT_FEAT_LE_PHY_2M(bt_dev.le.features)) {
963: 		err = bt_le_set_phy(conn, 0U, BT_HCI_LE_PHY_PREFER_2M,
964: 				    BT_HCI_LE_PHY_PREFER_2M,
965: 				    BT_HCI_LE_PHY_CODED_ANY);
966: 		if (!err) {
967: 			atomic_set_bit(conn->flags, BT_CONN_AUTO_PHY_UPDATE);
968: 			return;
969: 		}
970: 
971: 		BT_ERR("Failed to set LE PHY (%d)", err);
972: 	}
973: 
974: 	if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_AUTO_DATA_LEN_UPDATE) &&
975: 	    BT_FEAT_LE_DLE(bt_dev.le.features)) {
976: 		if (IS_BT_QUIRK_NO_AUTO_DLE(&bt_dev)) {
977: 			uint16_t tx_octets, tx_time;
978: 
979: 			err = hci_le_read_max_data_len(&tx_octets, &tx_time);
980: 			if (!err) {
981: 				err = bt_le_set_data_len(conn,
982: 						tx_octets, tx_time);
983: 				if (err) {
984: 					BT_ERR("Failed to set data len (%d)", err);
985: 				}
986: 			}
987: 		} else {
988: 			/* No need to auto-initiate DLE procedure.
989: 			 * It is done by the controller.
990: 			 */
991: 		}
992: 	}
993: }

995: static void le_conn_complete_cancel(void)
996: {
997: 	struct bt_conn *conn;
998: 
999: 	/* Handle create connection cancel.
1000: 	 *
1001: 	 * There is no need to check ID address as only one
1002: 	 * connection in central role can be in pending state.
1003: 	 */
1004: 	conn = find_pending_connect(BT_HCI_ROLE_CENTRAL, NULL);
1005: 	if (!conn) {
1006: 		BT_ERR("No pending central connection");
1007: 		return;
1008: 	}
1009: 
1010: 	conn->err = BT_HCI_ERR_UNKNOWN_CONN_ID;
1011: 
1012: 	/* Handle cancellation of outgoing connection attempt. */
1013: 	if (!IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_FILTER_ACCEPT_LIST)) {
1014: 		/* We notify before checking autoconnect flag
1015: 		 * as application may choose to change it from
1016: 		 * callback.
1017: 		 */
1018: 		bt_conn_set_state(conn, BT_CONN_DISCONNECTED);
1019: 		/* Check if device is marked for autoconnect. */
1020: 		if (atomic_test_bit(conn->flags, BT_CONN_AUTO_CONNECT)) {
1021: 			/* Restart passive scanner for device */
1022: 			bt_conn_set_state(conn, BT_CONN_CONNECT_SCAN);
1023: 		}
1024: 	} else {
1025: 		if (atomic_test_bit(conn->flags, BT_CONN_AUTO_CONNECT)) {
1026: 			/* Restart FAL initiator after RPA timeout. */
1027: 			bt_le_create_conn(conn);
1028: 		} else {
1029: 			/* Create connection canceled by timeout */
1030: 			bt_conn_set_state(conn, BT_CONN_DISCONNECTED);
1031: 		}
1032: 	}
1033: 
1034: 	bt_conn_unref(conn);
1035: }

1037: static void le_conn_complete_adv_timeout(void)
1038: {
1039: 	if (!(IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_EXT_ADV) &&
1040: 	      BT_DEV_FEAT_LE_EXT_ADV(bt_dev.le.features))) {
1041: 		struct bt_le_ext_adv *adv = bt_le_adv_lookup_legacy();
1042: 		struct bt_conn *conn;
1043: 
1044: 		/* Handle advertising timeout after high duty cycle directed
1045: 		 * advertising.
1046: 		 */
1047: 
1048: 		atomic_clear_bit(adv->flags, BT_ADV_ENABLED);
1049: 
1050: 		if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_EXT_ADV) &&
1051: 		    !BT_DEV_FEAT_LE_EXT_ADV(bt_dev.le.features)) {
1052: 			/* No advertising set terminated event, must be a
1053: 			 * legacy advertiser set.
1054: 			 */
1055: 			bt_le_adv_delete_legacy();
1056: 		}
1057: 
1058: 		/* There is no need to check ID address as only one
1059: 		 * connection in peripheral role can be in pending state.
1060: 		 */
1061: 		conn = find_pending_connect(BT_HCI_ROLE_PERIPHERAL, NULL);
1062: 		if (!conn) {
1063: 			BT_ERR("No pending peripheral connection");
1064: 			return;
1065: 		}
1066: 
1067: 		conn->err = BT_HCI_ERR_ADV_TIMEOUT;
1068: 		bt_conn_set_state(conn, BT_CONN_DISCONNECTED);
1069: 
1070: 		bt_conn_unref(conn);
1071: 	}
1072: }

1074: static void enh_conn_complete(struct bt_hci_evt_le_enh_conn_complete *evt)
1075: {
1076: #if (CONFIG_BT_ID_MAX > 1) && (CONFIG_BT_EXT_ADV_MAX_ADV_SET > 1)
1077: 	if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_PERIPHERAL) &&
1078: 		evt->role == BT_HCI_ROLE_PERIPHERAL &&
1079: 		evt->status == BT_HCI_ERR_SUCCESS &&
1080: 		(IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_EXT_ADV) &&
1081: 				BT_FEAT_LE_EXT_ADV(bt_dev.le.features))) {
1082: 
1083: 		/* Cache the connection complete event. Process it later.
1084: 		 * See bt_dev.cached_conn_complete.
1085: 		 */
1086: 		for (int i = 0; i < ARRAY_SIZE(bt_dev.cached_conn_complete); i++) {
1087: 			if (!bt_dev.cached_conn_complete[i].valid) {
1088: 				(void)memcpy(&bt_dev.cached_conn_complete[i].evt,
1089: 					evt,
1090: 					sizeof(struct bt_hci_evt_le_enh_conn_complete));
1091: 				bt_dev.cached_conn_complete[i].valid = true;
1092: 				return;
1093: 			}
1094: 		}
1095: 
1096: 		__ASSERT(false, "No more cache entries available."
1097: 				"This should not happen by design");
1098: 
1099: 		return;
1100: 	}
1101: #endif
1102: 	bt_hci_le_enh_conn_complete(evt);
1103: }

1105: void bt_hci_le_enh_conn_complete(struct bt_hci_evt_le_enh_conn_complete *evt)
1106: {
1107: 	uint16_t handle = sys_le16_to_cpu(evt->handle);
1108: 	bool is_disconnected = conn_handle_is_disconnected(handle);
1109: 	bt_addr_le_t peer_addr, id_addr;
1110: 	struct bt_conn *conn;
1111: 
1112: 	BT_DBG("status 0x%02x handle %u role %u peer %s peer RPA %s",
1113: 	       evt->status, handle, evt->role, bt_addr_le_str(&evt->peer_addr),
1114: 	       bt_addr_str(&evt->peer_rpa));
1115: 	BT_DBG("local RPA %s", bt_addr_str(&evt->local_rpa));
1116: 
1117: #if defined(CONFIG_BT_SMP)
1118: 	bt_id_pending_keys_update();
1119: #endif
1120: 
1121: 	if (evt->status) {
1122: 		if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_PERIPHERAL) &&
1123: 		    evt->status == BT_HCI_ERR_ADV_TIMEOUT) {
1124: 			le_conn_complete_adv_timeout();
1125: 			return;
1126: 		}
1127: 
1128: 		if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_CENTRAL) &&
1129: 		    evt->status == BT_HCI_ERR_UNKNOWN_CONN_ID) {
1130: 			le_conn_complete_cancel();
1131: 			bt_le_scan_update(false);
1132: 			return;
1133: 		}
1134: 
1135: 		BT_WARN("Unexpected status 0x%02x", evt->status);
1136: 
1137: 		return;
1138: 	}
1139: 
1140: 	/* Translate "enhanced" identity address type to normal one */
1141: 	if (evt->peer_addr.type == BT_ADDR_LE_PUBLIC_ID ||
1142: 	    evt->peer_addr.type == BT_ADDR_LE_RANDOM_ID) {
1143: 		bt_addr_le_copy(&id_addr, &evt->peer_addr);
1144: 		id_addr.type -= BT_ADDR_LE_PUBLIC_ID;
1145: 
1146: 		bt_addr_copy(&peer_addr.a, &evt->peer_rpa);
1147: 		peer_addr.type = BT_ADDR_LE_RANDOM;
1148: 	} else {
1149: 		uint8_t id = evt->role == BT_HCI_ROLE_PERIPHERAL ? bt_dev.adv_conn_id :
1150: 							   BT_ID_DEFAULT;
1151: 
1152: 		bt_addr_le_copy(&id_addr,
1153: 				bt_lookup_id_addr(id, &evt->peer_addr));
1154: 		bt_addr_le_copy(&peer_addr, &evt->peer_addr);
1155: 	}
1156: 
1157: 	conn = find_pending_connect(evt->role, &id_addr);
1158: 
1159: 	if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_PERIPHERAL) &&
1160: 	    evt->role == BT_HCI_ROLE_PERIPHERAL &&
1161: 	    !(IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_EXT_ADV) &&
1162: 	      BT_DEV_FEAT_LE_EXT_ADV(bt_dev.le.features))) {
1163: 		struct bt_le_ext_adv *adv = bt_le_adv_lookup_legacy();
1164: 		/* Clear advertising even if we are not able to add connection
1165: 		 * object to keep host in sync with controller state.
1166: 		 */
1167: 		atomic_clear_bit(adv->flags, BT_ADV_ENABLED);
1168: 		(void)bt_le_lim_adv_cancel_timeout(adv);
1169: 	}
1170: 
1171: 	if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_CENTRAL) &&
1172: 	    evt->role == BT_HCI_ROLE_CENTRAL) {
1173: 		/* Clear initiating even if we are not able to add connection
1174: 		 * object to keep the host in sync with controller state.
1175: 		 */
1176: 		atomic_clear_bit(bt_dev.flags, BT_DEV_INITIATING);
1177: 	}
1178: 
1179: 	if (!conn) {
1180: 		BT_ERR("No pending conn for peer %s",
1181: 		       bt_addr_le_str(&evt->peer_addr));
1182: 		bt_hci_disconnect(handle, BT_HCI_ERR_UNSPECIFIED);
1183: 		return;
1184: 	}
1185: 
1186: 	conn->handle = handle;
1187: 	bt_addr_le_copy(&conn->le.dst, &id_addr);
1188: 	conn->le.interval = sys_le16_to_cpu(evt->interval);
1189: 	conn->le.latency = sys_le16_to_cpu(evt->latency);
1190: 	conn->le.timeout = sys_le16_to_cpu(evt->supv_timeout);
1191: 	conn->role = evt->role;
1192: 	conn->err = 0U;
1193: 
1194: #if defined(CONFIG_BT_USER_DATA_LEN_UPDATE)
1195: 	conn->le.data_len.tx_max_len = BT_GAP_DATA_LEN_DEFAULT;
1196: 	conn->le.data_len.tx_max_time = BT_GAP_DATA_TIME_DEFAULT;
1197: 	conn->le.data_len.rx_max_len = BT_GAP_DATA_LEN_DEFAULT;
1198: 	conn->le.data_len.rx_max_time = BT_GAP_DATA_TIME_DEFAULT;
1199: #endif
1200: 
1201: #if defined(CONFIG_BT_USER_PHY_UPDATE)
1202: 	conn->le.phy.tx_phy = BT_GAP_LE_PHY_1M;
1203: 	conn->le.phy.rx_phy = BT_GAP_LE_PHY_1M;
1204: #endif
1205: 	/*
1206: 	 * Use connection address (instead of identity address) as initiator
1207: 	 * or responder address. Only peripheral needs to be updated. For central all
1208: 	 * was set during outgoing connection creation.
1209: 	 */
1210: 	if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_PERIPHERAL) &&
1211: 	    conn->role == BT_HCI_ROLE_PERIPHERAL) {
1212: 		bt_addr_le_copy(&conn->le.init_addr, &peer_addr);
1213: 
1214: 		if (!(IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_EXT_ADV) &&
1215: 		      BT_DEV_FEAT_LE_EXT_ADV(bt_dev.le.features))) {
1216: 			struct bt_le_ext_adv *adv = bt_le_adv_lookup_legacy();
1217: 
1218: 			if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_PRIVACY) &&
1219: 			    !atomic_test_bit(adv->flags, BT_ADV_USE_IDENTITY)) {
1220: 				conn->le.resp_addr.type = BT_ADDR_LE_RANDOM;
1221: 				if (bt_addr_cmp(&evt->local_rpa,
1222: 						BT_ADDR_ANY) != 0) {
1223: 					bt_addr_copy(&conn->le.resp_addr.a,
1224: 						     &evt->local_rpa);
1225: 				} else {
1226: 					bt_addr_copy(&conn->le.resp_addr.a,
1227: 						     &bt_dev.random_addr.a);
1228: 				}
1229: 			} else {
1230: 				bt_addr_le_copy(&conn->le.resp_addr,
1231: 						&bt_dev.id_addr[conn->id]);
1232: 			}
1233: 		} else {
1234: 			/* Copy the local RPA and handle this in advertising set
1235: 			 * terminated event.
1236: 			 */
1237: 			bt_addr_copy(&conn->le.resp_addr.a, &evt->local_rpa);
1238: 		}
1239: 
1240: 		/* if the controller supports, lets advertise for another
1241: 		 * peripheral connection.
1242: 		 * check for connectable advertising state is sufficient as
1243: 		 * this is how this le connection complete for peripheral occurred.
1244: 		 */
1245: 		if (BT_LE_STATES_PER_CONN_ADV(bt_dev.le.states)) {
1246: 			bt_le_adv_resume();
1247: 		}
1248: 
1249: 		if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_EXT_ADV) &&
1250: 		    !BT_DEV_FEAT_LE_EXT_ADV(bt_dev.le.features)) {
1251: 			struct bt_le_ext_adv *adv = bt_le_adv_lookup_legacy();
1252: 			/* No advertising set terminated event, must be a
1253: 			 * legacy advertiser set.
1254: 			 */
1255: 			if (!atomic_test_bit(adv->flags, BT_ADV_PERSIST)) {
1256: 				bt_le_adv_delete_legacy();
1257: 			}
1258: 		}
1259: 	}
1260: 
1261: 	if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_CENTRAL) &&
1262: 	    conn->role == BT_HCI_ROLE_CENTRAL) {
1263: 		bt_addr_le_copy(&conn->le.resp_addr, &peer_addr);
1264: 
1265: 		if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_PRIVACY)) {
1266: 			conn->le.init_addr.type = BT_ADDR_LE_RANDOM;
1267: 			if (bt_addr_cmp(&evt->local_rpa, BT_ADDR_ANY) != 0) {
1268: 				bt_addr_copy(&conn->le.init_addr.a,
1269: 					     &evt->local_rpa);
1270: 			} else {
1271: 				bt_addr_copy(&conn->le.init_addr.a,
1272: 					     &bt_dev.random_addr.a);
1273: 			}
1274: 		} else {
1275: 			bt_addr_le_copy(&conn->le.init_addr,
1276: 					&bt_dev.id_addr[conn->id]);
1277: 		}
1278: 	}
1279: 
1280: #if defined(CONFIG_BT_USER_PHY_UPDATE)
1281: 	if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_EXT_ADV) &&
1282: 	    BT_DEV_FEAT_LE_EXT_ADV(bt_dev.le.features)) {
1283: 		int err;
1284: 
1285: 		err = hci_le_read_phy(conn);
1286: 		if (err) {
1287: 			BT_WARN("Failed to read PHY (%d)", err);
1288: 		} else {
1289: 			if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_AUTO_PHY_UPDATE) &&
1290: 			    conn->le.phy.tx_phy == BT_HCI_LE_PHY_PREFER_2M &&
1291: 			    conn->le.phy.rx_phy == BT_HCI_LE_PHY_PREFER_2M) {
1292: 				/* Already on 2M, skip auto-phy update. */
1293: 				atomic_set_bit(conn->flags,
1294: 					       BT_CONN_AUTO_PHY_COMPLETE);
1295: 			}
1296: 		}
1297: 	}
1298: #endif /* defined(CONFIG_BT_USER_PHY_UPDATE) */
1299: 
1300: 	bt_conn_set_state(conn, BT_CONN_CONNECTED);
1301: 
1302: 	if (is_disconnected) {
1303: 		/* Mark the connection as already disconnected before calling
1304: 		 * the connected callback, so that the application cannot
1305: 		 * start sending packets
1306: 		 */
1307: 		bt_conn_set_state(conn, BT_CONN_DISCONNECT_COMPLETE);
1308: 	}
1309: 
1310: 	bt_conn_connected(conn);
1311: 
1312: 	/* Start auto-initiated procedures */
1313: 	conn_auto_initiate(conn);
1314: 
1315: 	bt_conn_unref(conn);
1316: 
1317: 	if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_BT_CENTRAL) &&
1318: 	    conn->role == BT_HCI_ROLE_CENTRAL) {
1319: 		bt_le_scan_update(false);
1320: 	}
1321: }

1458: bool bt_le_conn_params_valid(const struct bt_le_conn_param *param)
1459: {
1460: 	/* All limits according to BT Core spec 5.0 [Vol 2, Part E, 7.8.12] */
1461: 
1462: 	if (param->interval_min > param->interval_max ||
1463: 	    param->interval_min < 6 || param->interval_max > 3200) {
1464: 		return false;
1465: 	}
1466: 
1467: 	if (param->latency > 499) {
1468: 		return false;
1469: 	}
1470: 
1471: 	if (param->timeout < 10 || param->timeout > 3200 ||
1472: 	    ((param->timeout * 4U) <=
1473: 	     ((1U + param->latency) * param->interval_max))) {
1474: 		return false;
1475: 	}
1476: 
1477: 	return true;
1478: }

1551: static void le_conn_update_complete(struct net_buf *buf)
1552: {
1553: #if defined(CONFIG_BT_CONN)
1554: 	struct bt_hci_evt_le_conn_update_complete *evt = (void *)buf->data;
